data.config.yaml:
cpu:
  preferredMeters:
  - rapl
  - hwmon
debug:
  pprof:
    enabled: false
dev:
  fake-cpu-meter:
    enabled: false
    zones: []
  fake-gpu-meter:
    deviceCount: 1
    enabled: false
    sharingMode: time-slicing
experimental:
  gpu:
    dcgmEndpoint: ""
    enabled: false
    idlePower: 0
    metricsCacheTTL: 2s
  hwmon:
    chipRules: []
    forceEnabled: false
    zones: []
  platform:
    redfish:
      configFile: /etc/kepler/redfish.yaml
      enabled: false
      httpTimeout: 5s
      nodeName: ""
exporter:
  prometheus:
    debugCollectors:
    - go
    enabled: true
    metricsLevel:
    - node
    - process
    - container
    - vm
    - pod
  stdout:
    enabled: false
host:
  procfs: /host/proc
  sysfs: /host/sys
kube:
  config: ""
  enabled: false
  nodeName: ""
  podInformer:
    mode: kubelet
    pollInterval: 15s
log:
  format: text
  level: debug
monitor:
  interval: 5s
  maxTerminated: 100
  minTerminatedEnergyThreshold: 10
  staleness: 500ms
rapl:
  zones: []
web:
  configFile: ""
  listenAddresses:
  - :28282
